exposure: Various risk factors for severe postpartum hemorrhage
outcome: Discrimination, calibration, and net benefit of preoperative and intraoperative nomograms
cohort: 865 patients in the development cohort and 307 patients in the validation cohort with placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: The study developed and validated two nomograms (preoperative and intraoperative) to predict the risk of SPPH in women with placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery, with the intraoperative nomogram showing better performance.
mod_finding: The study developed nomograms to predict the risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage in women with placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery.
